name: An Adventurer's Woes
description: To provide assistance to Nod-Krai's adventurers, the Adventurers' Guild has also placed an order with Aino...

dialogs.content: Ah, Miss Aino. You're here...
#Hmm? Aren't you the legendary {NICKNAME} and {M#his}{F#her} fairy companion?
You know us?

My name is Sarin, and I'm the Branch Master of Nod-Krai's Adventurers' Guild. Just think about your reputation in the Guild... If I didn't know you, it would be a serious dereliction of my duties, wouldn't it?
Huh, that makes sense!
Ah, so you know each other! But lemme just confirm, which order's yours again?
Paimon's curious too. What kind of help would the Guild need from Aino?
Well... You know how it is. An adventurer's biggest obstacle out in the wild are the various enemies that stand in their way.
In other regions, the Guild can collaborate with local authorities to provide some protection for adventurers. But in a place like Nod-Krai, we can only rely on ourselves.
So recently, I've come up with an idea: To design a self-defense device that any adventurer can carry around. That way, even less-skilled adventurers can fend off powerful foes!
But... Haha, well, let's just say my attempt ended in failure. And since I lack the talent to get the job done, I may as well hire a professional to help me out.
Oh yeah, that one! It's a good idea, but the design? Yeesh...
And that is why we have asked you, Aino... Ah, I mean Miss Aino, for her invaluable assistance!
The hard part about this one, Sarin, is that the device you've designed uses tech from elsewhere... It can't adapt to Nod-Krai's kuuvahki-rich environments, y'see.
I mean, what we need to do isn't complicated. We just need to use his device, find some bad guys, beat them up for testing, then tweak the design as needed.
And when testing, I'll be able to gather some data about kuuvahki-rich environments! So it's a win-win order.
Buuut, I'm not helping out with the fighting. If the device breaks down when you're surrounded, you'll only have your fists to rely on!
No problem.
I'll leave it in your capable hands, then. If you need anything, just let me know. The Guild will ensure that your reward for a successful order is most generous!
Great. My fists have been itching for some faces.
